notes: Rows follow the approved 147-path first data pass: 146 parsed Fandom Unit Evolution paths plus manually cross-checked Alocard -> Alocard (Vampire King).
Public cards use materialSummary instead of exact requirement fields because full per-unit quantities/Gold are only extracted for rows with available row-level template/rendered proof in this pass.
Signature evolution item names and sources come from cached Fandom Module:ItemData/data evolution_usage entries plus row-level Fandom proof for Gilgamesh, Haruka Rin, and Vogita Super (Awakened).
Result rarity and base rarity come from the local Anime Vanguards units dataset, which is backed by Unit List and UnitData modules.
Images are intentionally blank for the data phase and should be collected by the image skill.
unresolvedGaps: Full required material quantities and Gold costs remain incomplete for 141 rows; those rows expose only source-backed signature-item summaries in public card fields.
Current obtainability/limited/unobtainable labels are not fully normalized across all 147 rows.
Update 13.5 remains a freshness gate; no row was added beyond the approved 147 without row-level proof.
imageNotes: Image pass reused clean evolved-unit pose images already saved in the local Anime Vanguards Units public image set.
Every evolution row matched by evolved-unit slug, then the image was copied into the Evolutions public image folder.
No base-unit fallback images were needed.
